title: Implement strings.py: string extraction, classification, scoring
description:
Create src/psp_etl/strings.py implementing:
- STRING_PATTERN: regex for printable ASCII runs >= 6 chars
- CATEGORIES dict with regexes for format_string, function_name, error_message, postcode
- WEIGHTS: format_string=3, function_name=2, error_message=2, postcode=1, descriptive=0.5, other=0.1
- classify_string(s) -> category
- analyze_blob(blob_path) -> StringAnalysis dataclass
- Shannon entropy calculation for suspected mis-classified encrypted blobs
- See DESIGN.md Phase 3 for exact patterns and logic
